notes.title: Flight Catastrophe: Let's take a look behind the scenes
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, community![/h2]


Do you feel the excitement of the vacations in the air? The days are longer, and we all have more time for our favorite hobbies!
If you're here, it means you love the same things we do.
The games!

We are working on new features for the air gameplay and that is what we are focusing all our work on right now. We have also created a new main menu and our airport has been expanded a bit! The Flight Catastrophe is getting bigger and more serious all the time, and we can't wait to show you what we've been working on. 

[h3]We can't wait to hear your thoughts! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38415958/ba4388fe9b9b9d62858ad501c670ba11c795ad13.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38415958/350d9aa07df664b0a99ccbb19f223be6d5f0d90a.png[/img]


[h3]Let's talk![/h3]

We'd love for you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/3FYTduTkz4]Discord[/url] community and share your brilliant ideas with us! Or maybe you have some questions? We're here for you, so don't be shy!

notes.title: Flight Catastrophe : In the skies & on land
notes.content:
[h2]Exciting progress in the development of the Flight Catastrophe game![/h2]


We're excited to share some fantastic updates on the development of Flight Catastrophe, our upcoming game where players take on the challenging role of preventing airline disasters. The journey has been exciting, and we're excited to showcase the latest developments.

One of the most significant advances we've made is expanding the game beyond the skies. Yes, you heard right! Flight Catastrophe now includes not only exciting challenges in the air, but also [b]allows players to manage airports and fleets of aircraft on the ground[/b]. This expansion opens up a whole new dimension of gameplay, offering players a more immersive and diverse experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38415958/f9fb4cd58264cf6de9c87dfa1701399d59622762.png[/img]

Imagine not only preventing disasters in the skies, but also strategically organizing smooth operations on the ground. From building buildings and buying new planes, to managing your aircrew.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38415958/42f1fbd2738691e9eab36167c2ccf4086781ed8b.gif[/img]

What's more, ground duties will also require good financial and time management. Yes, the player's decisions in relation to aircraft flights also occur here! How many flights in a row can you fly? More flights mean more money, but also a greater chance for something to go wrong during the flight.... 
Stay tuned for more updates, and let's make aviation history together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38415958/31615d86fd9b40fa2ef743b53dac0d2100076b0b.png[/img]

Fly high!
Trigger Labs Team
